decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt was publicly announced as an extension of the brand's popular biodynamic range, fits the firm's core organic positioning and uses existing dairy capacity, so dropping it would write off a visible commitment with little gain.

The mild sliced cheese, launched in 2024 with its own product page, draws on the firm's in-house cheesemaking and is too new for weak early results to be seen as anything but temporary, so management will persist.
The sliced butter cheese has its own visible presentation and sits close to the core cheese business at low incremental cost, and its first year is too short to justify abandoning it.
